study.question: Does removing the blockwise click-stratum action centroid destroy the match-action contribution that survived mean-only replacement, and is the effect specific to true strata or residual-bank task routing?
study.hypothesis: Under the frozen model and offline inputs, the useful match-action component is concentrated in action variation between true historical-click strata. True-stratum centroids preserve most click utility, whereas their complementary within-stratum deviations lose it; shifted-stratum deviations retain more of the original click contrast. A reversal of true-versus-shifted ordering in residual-only cells, following the positive ordering in mean-only cells, would be provisional evidence for this localization. Routing can modulate that effect. This is not a claim that binary click membership alone is sufficient or that all feedback dependence is removed.

study.proposed_difference:
Observed round44 mean click AUC: true/task=0.665987768080729, true/shared=0.664820566975296, shifted/task=0.663914176574100, shifted/shared=0.662089055859262. True-minus-shifted deltas=0.002073591506629 task, 0.002731511116034 shared; interaction=-0.000657919609405. Round43 within-stratum rotation AUCs0.665874061702269/0.664590603574180 versus shifted0.663728016804622/0.661896410629108 show the same ordering. True means are within0.0005 of true rotation per routing, while true-minus-shifted exceeds0.001. These satisfy prior qualitative single-seed predictions but do not certify the mechanism: all latest candidate_diagnostics are not_requested. The round37 aligned stopped observed model scores0.666169380047053 task/0.664605821752815 shared; blocked item duplicate scores0.663623597433105/0.661734767071086, and unrestricted stopped rotation scores0.663743611195438 task. Content replacement and destruction branches failed to retain utility; basis-transport branches in round42 retained about0.66622 task but did not establish a new mechanism. Early context-code replacement scored0.641429687032185 versus incumbent0.666753547526167, an optimization-confounded failure rather than evidence that no contextual representation could work. DIN remains0.655544082420034. Review these unsuccessful branches with the latest centroid results rather than interpreting only the positive path.
New change: for each sample and ten-position block let P_g average incoming action embeddings over original valid positions within the two declared click/shifted strata. Only the action coordinates supplied to match rows0/4 become R_g A=A-P_g A. The subtraction executes in disabled-autocast FP32, then casts back before unchanged contractions. Parent mean and rotate branches remain for bridge checks. Valid singleton or homogeneous strata yield zero residual; invalid values are preserved locally but never source valid contributions and remain excluded by every original mask. Item values and coefficients stay fixed. Mean and complement reconstruct observed actions in exact arithmetic, but BF16/cast/reduction residuals require measurement. Residuals retain within-group auxiliary composition and group-dependent centering, may encode membership implicitly, and need not have the same norm or rank as centroids. This asks whether the centroid contribution is needed by this representation, not whether it is the unique source of predictive information.
Four residual cells cross partition true/shifted with routing task/shared. Reuse corresponding four round44 mean cells only after source bridge checks; no duplicate training is requested. No extra trainable capacity, state, RNG, loss or visibility change. Expected counts inherited32129765 total/31793216 embedding/336549 dense, to be measured by host. Keep unchanged incumbent, DIN, original observed/shared references and context-code control in reporting; this proposal does not select a replacement for the incumbent.
predictions: Primary practical prediction: residual true-minus-shifted click AUC is <=-0.001 in each routing, reversing the round44 positive mean deltas. Thresholds are practical margins, not significance cutoffs.

Secondary practical prediction: true residual loses >=0.001 click AUC versus the corresponding round44 true mean in each routing. A shifted residual may remain within0.0005 of the aligned stopped observed reference; treat this last prediction as exploratory.

At fixed parameters only stopped action summary rows0/4 differ. Exact arithmetic group residual sums are zero, P(RA)=0, R(PA)=0, R(RA)=RA and PA+RA=A on valid positions; singleton/homogeneous valid strata vanish.

A routing interaction remains exploratory. Report the residual partition deltas and their difference, plus the change from the round44 interaction; repeated seeds/user-cluster uncertainty are required before repeated support.
falsifiers: True residual retains true-mean utility within0.0005, or true residual is no worse than shifted residual: this weakens the proposed localization and necessity account.

Both residual partitions lose similarly, especially if norms/effective ranks or optimizer behavior explain the result: a nonspecific projection disruption is not support for historical-click localization.
Residual output is nearly zero or the final changed summaries are rarely active: report weak identification and distinguish mathematical annihilation from a learned performance effect.

Any changed original mask/scorer population/item path/ordinary pool/ordinal row or gradient ownership, failed source bridge, nonfinite output or failed invalid-position invariance invalidates controlled attribution.
Mean and complement cannot be numerically certified at declared tolerances, or future paired repetitions reverse ordering: retain results as exploratory and do not declare a mechanism.
alternative_explanations: Equal parameter count does not match effective rank, feature RMS or optimization difficulty; projections and complements retain different dimensions.
True/shifted partitions match group sizes but differ in semantic composition and orientation; a residual advantage cannot establish that membership is absent.
Auxiliary feedback composition remains inside each click stratum; original pools/ordinal rows/task masks retain feedback in every cell.
All existing results use one frozen seed; host tensor diagnostic receipts are absent, and repeated exposures share users.

For each submitted source override summary_stratum_operator=mean and certify exact source bridge against its materialized round44 counterpart: identical named state/init/RNG, buffers, four predictions, BCE, dense/coalesced sparse gradients (including None vs zero), and one frozen optimizer update. Check scratch and a common nonzero residual-bank state in FP32 and BF16 train/eval; zero final layers make scratch prediction agreement insufficient. Then run finite forward/backward on all residual cells and measure equal initial state/parameter counts. Compare the actual tensor helper to independent direct masked averages/residuals. Verify PA+RA=A on valid positions; zero residual group sums, P(RA)=R(PA)=0, R(RA)=RA, orthogonality, energy decomposition and norm contraction; singleton and homogeneous strata yield zero residual, empty histories are safe, and shifted partitions preserve true group counts. Invalid destinations keep inherited values; invalid sources never contribute. No source crosses a stratum/block/sample. Verify source-exclusion by perturbing invalid values while holding legal masks, plus target action; require four-output invariance for empty/singleton/partial/noncontiguous/full histories, and malformed/absent task masks must fail. At fixed parameters only action rows0/4 may change: all item summaries, match counts/coefficients, ordinal action rows1/2/3, pool/scorer interactions, weights/populations, original validity/task masks, gradient ownership and RNG/buffers must agree. Local action-input derivatives from final rows0/4 stay zero; ordinary pool/ordinal action derivatives and allowed context derivatives remain. Do not assert the whole action-table gradient is zero. Predeclared tolerances: exact integer masks/counts and unchanged branches; FP32 projection/bridge/reconstruction residual <=2e-5+2e-5*maxabs(reference); BF16 reductions <=0.02+0.02*maxabs(reference), probability abs<=0.002. For nonzero bridge/projection gradients require relative L2<=1e-4 FP32 or0.05 BF16, denominator floor1e-12, plus elementwise bounds near zero. For orthogonality/energy use normalized absolute residual <=1e-4 FP32 or0.05 BF16 with energy denominator floor1e-12. Report maxima/RMS, retain failures, never widen after scoring. Measure training-only stratum occupancy/singletons/homogeneity, projection and complement energy, actual changed-token/summary fraction and match-row RMS at initialization/common saved state. Include zero and near-zero groups. These diagnostics cannot tune scales or select a new grouping. Different effective ranks/RMS are explicit confounds even with equal modules. Any unavailable or failed certificate prevents controlled attribution; a successful score alone is not a certificate.
